description: Sounce Ultimate Cable Protector | Spiral Triple Colour 1.5 Meter / 150 cm | Plastic Cord Wire Charger Winder for iPhone and Android Charging Cables (Pack of 3) - Distributed/Packaged by Sounce. Product Details: Protect and extend the life of your charging cables with the Sounce Ultimate Cable Protector, a 1.5-meter triple-color spiral wrap designed to reduce fraying, bending, and internal wire breakage by over 80%. Compatible with iPhone, Android, and virtually all USB, headphone, or laptop charger cables, this flexible PVC protector offers a snug, stylish, and durable solution that enhances cable longevity at a fraction of the replacement cost. Easy to install and built for everyday use, it prevents wear while adding a vibrant touch to your tech accessories. Ideal for anyone who relies on daily charging, it’s also a smart and practical gift for friends, family, or colleagues. Comes in a convenient pack of 3.
